subject.title: [security] Egress status exposes host/client bridge state to use-share recipients

question: Should `use` share recipients receive any per-side egress bridge connection state from the status API?
rationale: The source evidence shows the current endpoint crosses the documented `use`/`manage` boundary, but maintainers should choose whether compatibility favors redaction, a manage-only endpoint, or a documented coarse status contract.

options.title: Redact per-side booleans for non-managers
options.body: Preserve the existing visible status endpoint while hiding `hostConnected` and `clientConnected` behind the same manage gate as session metadata.

options.title: Make status manage-only
options.body: Return 403 for non-manage callers, which is simpler but may break existing shared-view clients that poll the endpoint.

options.title: Document accepted use-role status
options.body: Keep exposing a limited status only if maintainers intentionally accept that host/client bridge state is part of the `use` contract.

recommendation.title: Redact per-side booleans for non-managers
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing visible status endpoint while hiding `hostConnected` and `clientConnected` behind the same manage gate as session metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the egress feature, lease sharing, and the prior bridge-diagnostics redaction fix.
